intro.h2: Stone Countertops and Remodels From a Martin Shop
paragraphs: Quality Kitchens & Baths handles granite countertops in Martin, TN from its shop at 7657 Hwy 45 S. Slabs stand on racks right beside the building, and the Facebook page sums up the specialty in one line: granite, quartz, solid surface and cultured marble.

The people come up as often as the stone. Reviewers name Mike and Heather again and again, call them super folks to work with during a remodel, and describe the whole crew as talented, kind and willing to make you happy. Another reviewer points to a great selection of bathroom material. The shop is open on weekdays from 9 AM to 4 PM.

items.name: Granite countertops
items.blurb: Granite leads the specialty list on the Quality Kitchens & Baths Facebook page, and slabs are stored on racks at the Hwy 45 S shop. Come see the colours and patterns in person, then talk through how the top will fit your cabinets and sink.

image.alt: Granite slabs in white, grey and tan standing on racks outside the Quality Kitchens & Baths shop in Martin, TN

items.name: Quartz countertops
items.blurb: Quartz is the second material named in the shop's Facebook specialty list. Ask to compare quartz and granite side by side for your kitchen or bath, and check which colours they can get for your project before you make a final choice.

items.name: Solid surface and cultured marble tops
items.blurb: Solid surface and cultured marble round out the materials the shop specializes in. Both are often used for bathroom vanity tops, and vanity tops are among the jobs reviewers mention. Ask which sizes and colours suit your bathroom and how long they take.

about.text: Quality Kitchens & Baths is a kitchen remodeler and countertop shop at 7657 Hwy 45 S in Martin, Tennessee. Its Facebook page describes the specialty as granite, quartz, solid surface and cultured marble, and the yard beside the building holds racks of stone slabs. Mike and Heather are the names reviewers mention most, along with a crew described as talented and kind. One reviewer sums it up simply: the owner knows what he's doing. The shop has 401 followers on Facebook and a 4.7 rating from 17 Google reviews.
about.owner_role: Named together in reviews; a Google review highlight says 'Owner knows what he's doing'; last names and titles not published

steps.title: Visit or call
steps.text: Stop by 7657 Hwy 45 S on a weekday between 9 AM and 4 PM, or call (731) 431-9944 to talk about your kitchen or bath.

steps.title: Pick your material
steps.text: Look at the granite slabs on site and ask about quartz, solid surface and cultured marble for the tops you need.

steps.title: Measure and plan
steps.text: The space is measured so the tops fit your cabinets. Ask how measuring and templating are handled for your particular job.

steps.title: Install and walkthrough
steps.text: The crew installs the tops. Check the seams, edges and fit together before they leave, and raise anything you want adjusted.

service_area.h2: Granite Countertops for Martin, TN Homes
service_area.text: Quality Kitchens & Baths works from 7657 Hwy 45 S in Martin, Tennessee, and its Facebook page lists Martin as its home town. Google does not publish a wider service area. If you live outside Martin, call (731) 431-9944 to ask whether delivery and installation reach your home before you come in to choose a slab. Bring rough cabinet measurements when you visit.

items.a: The shop at 7657 Hwy 45 S in Martin is open Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 4 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday, according to Google. Call (731) 431-9944 before you come so someone is free to walk you through the slabs.

items.q: What countertop materials do you offer?
items.a: The Facebook page lists the specialty as granite, quartz, solid surface and cultured marble. Granite slabs are stored on racks at the shop, so you can see them in person. Ask about quartz colours, and about solid surface or cultured marble for vanity tops, when you call.

items.q: Do you do full kitchen and bath remodels?
items.a: Google lists Quality Kitchens & Baths as a kitchen remodeler, and reviewers describe Mike, Heather and their crew working with them through a remodel. One reviewer also mentions a great selection of bathroom material. Call to talk through your project and what the crew can take on.

items.q: Can I see slabs before I choose?
items.a: Yes. Granite slabs stand on racks beside the building at 7657 Hwy 45 S, as the shop photo shows. Visit during weekday hours to look at them in person, and ask what else can be ordered if you have a particular colour in mind.

items.q: How else can I reach you?
items.a: Call (731) 431-9944, or fax drawings and measurements to 731-588-2686, the fax number on the shop's sign. Email qualitykitchensandbaths@hotmail.com works too. Free estimates and financing are not published, so ask about them when you get in touch, along with the timing for your job.

final_cta.text: Visit the Hwy 45 S shop on a weekday or give Mike and Heather a call.
